item.title: Immortality and Resurrection: Possibility and How It Affects Religion
item.description: In Cyberpunk 2077, Saburo Arasaka does something that has fascinated humans since the beginning of civilization: he cheats death. They store his consciousness, copy it, and load into another body, his son’s body. It is fiction, but it draws from a real and accelerating field: what if we could one day save a person’s mind and put it somewhere else? The question sounds like science fiction, but serious researchers are working on exactly that. And if it ever becomes possible, it would force every major religion (Islam included) to answer some uncomfortable questions.
